Description: Authenticates user credentials (email + password) against Oracle PASSENGER/DRIVER tables. Returns JWT token, user role (ADMIN/DRIVER/PASSENGER), and profile info.
Registers a new user (Passenger/Driver/Admin). Inserts into the appropriate Oracle table. Validates email uniqueness, hashes password, returns JWT.
Retrieves all vehicles from the Oracle VEHICLE table. Supports optional query params for filtering by status, type.
Creates a new vehicle record in Oracle. Calls PL/SQL procedure SP_REGISTER_VEHICLE. Validates registration uniqueness and capacity > 0.
Retrieves a single vehicle by vehicleId from Oracle VEHICLE table. Includes assigned driver info via JOIN.
Updates an existing vehicle record. Validates registration uniqueness (excluding self). Updates status, capacity, model, etc.
Soft-deletes or deactivates a vehicle. Sets status to RETIRED. Checks no active trips are assigned.
Searches vehicles by registration number, type, or model. Uses Oracle LIKE queries across multiple columns.
Retrieves all drivers from Oracle DRIVER table. Includes rating and trip count aggregations.
Creates a new driver record. Validates license number uniqueness, email format, phone format.
Retrieves single driver by driverId. Includes assigned vehicle and recent trip history.
Updates driver profile info (name, phone, license, status).
Returns the authenticated driver's own profile using JWT-extracted userId.
Updates the authenticated driver's own profile.
Returns all trips assigned to the authenticated driver. Joins TRIP, ROUTE, VEHICLE tables.
Searches drivers by name, license number, or email.
Retrieves all routes from Oracle ROUTE table with trip counts.
Creates a new route. Validates origin != destination, checks for duplicate routes.
Retrieves single route by routeId with associated trip information.
Updates route info (origin, destination, distance, duration, status).
Deactivates a route. Sets status to INACTIVE. Checks no active trips reference it.
Searches routes by origin, destination, or description.
Retrieves all passengers from Oracle PASSENGER table. Admin-only endpoint.
Retrieves single passenger by passengerId with booking count.
Updates passenger info. Admin can update any passenger.
Deactivates/suspends a passenger account.
Returns the authenticated passenger's own profile using JWT-extracted userId.
Updates the authenticated passenger's own profile.
Searches passengers by name, email, or phone.
Retrieves all trips from Oracle TRIP table with route, vehicle, driver info via JOINs.
Schedules a new trip. Calls PL/SQL procedure SP_SCHEDULE_TRIP. Validates route/vehicle/driver exist, vehicle and driver available.
Retrieves single trip by tripId with full details (route, vehicle, driver, seat info).
Updates trip info (date, time, fare, status). Admin/driver endpoint.
Updates only the trip status (SCHEDULED→IN_PROGRESS→COMPLETED or CANCELLED). Driver can update own trips.
Searches trips by origin, destination, date, maxPrice. Public endpoint for passengers to find available trips.
Returns trips scheduled in the near future. Used by passenger dashboard.
Retrieves all bookings from Oracle BOOKING table. Admin-only. Joins PASSENGER, TRIP, ROUTE.
Creates a new booking. Calls PL/SQL procedure SP_CREATE_BOOKING. Checks seat availability, validates passenger/trip, creates booking record.
Retrieves single booking by bookingId with full trip/route/payment details.
Cancels a booking. Calls PL/SQL procedure SP_CANCEL_BOOKING. Updates booking status and releases seats.
Returns all bookings for the authenticated passenger using JWT-extracted userId.
Searches bookings by passenger name, route, or booking status.
Retrieves all payment records. Admin-only. Joins BOOKING, PASSENGER tables.
Processes a payment for a booking. Calls PL/SQL procedure SP_PROCESS_PAYMENT. Updates booking payment status.
Retrieves a single payment record by paymentId.
Retrieves payment record associated with a specific booking.
Retrieves all maintenance records from Oracle MAINTENANCE table. Joins VEHICLE.
Records new maintenance entry. Calls PL/SQL procedure SP_RECORD_MAINTENANCE. Links to vehicle.
Retrieves single maintenance record by maintenanceId.
Updates maintenance record (status, cost, description, next date).
Returns vehicles that are due or overdue for maintenance.
Searches maintenance records by vehicle registration, type, or technician.
Retrieves all feedback from Oracle FEEDBACK table. Joins PASSENGER, ROUTE.
Submits new feedback. Validates rating 1-5, links to passenger/route/vehicle/driver.
Retrieves single feedback by feedbackId.
Retrieves all feedback submitted by a specific passenger.
Searches feedback by comment text, type, or passenger name.
Retrieves all reviews from MongoDB reviews collection. Dynamic schema-flexible documents.
Submits a new review to MongoDB. Stores rating, comment, routeId, vehicleId, driverId, tags.
MongoDB Query 1: Retrieve all passenger reviews for a specific route. Uses db.reviews.find({routeId: N}).
MongoDB Query 2: Identify highest-rated vehicles/drivers. Uses aggregation pipeline ($group, $avg, $sort).
MongoDB Query 3: Search complaints/feedback by keyword. Uses $regex text matching on comment field.
Retrieves all announcements from MongoDB announcements collection.
Creates a new announcement. Stores title, message, targetAudience, priority in MongoDB.
Updates an existing announcement by MongoDB ObjectId.
Deletes/archives an announcement from MongoDB.
MongoDB Query 4: Retrieve vehicle documents (insurance, registration, etc.) from vehicle_documents collection.
Retrieves vehicle images from MongoDB. Links to Oracle vehicleId for hybrid display.
Uploads a new document for a vehicle. Stores metadata + file reference in MongoDB.
Deletes a vehicle document from MongoDB by ObjectId.
Retrieves all trip media from MongoDB trip_media collection.
Retrieves media for a specific trip. Used in trip detail pages for multimedia content.
Uploads trip media (image/video metadata). Stores in MongoDB trip_media collection.
Deletes trip media from MongoDB by ObjectId.
Report 1: Most Frequently Used Routes. Calls PL/SQL report procedure. Returns route + booking count ranked.
Report 2: Revenue Within Given Period. Calls PL/SQL function FN_CALCULATE_REVENUE. Returns total revenue, tickets, avg value.
Report 3: Passenger Travel History. Uses cursor to iterate through passenger's trips, bookings, payments.
Report 4: Vehicles Due for Maintenance. Queries MAINTENANCE table for overdue/upcoming records.
Report 5: Trip Occupancy & Performance. Calculates occupancy %, revenue per trip. Uses PL/SQL function FN_OCCUPANCY_RATE.
Dashboard aggregation endpoint. Returns totalVehicles, activeDrivers, todaysTrips, todaysBookings, todaysRevenue, maintenanceDue counts.
